semanticCases.given: Recognized disabled CRUD in any position.
semanticCases.expected: First unsupported pointer; no supported prefix, key claim or effects.

semanticCases.given: Support changes after CLI preflight.
semanticCases.expected: Authority rechecks all new members before admission.

semanticCases.given: Nonempty unsupported capabilityVersion with opaque new body.
semanticCases.expected: Capability Problem before interpreting unknown version language.

semanticCases.given: Version1 unknown/set-write operation.
semanticCases.expected: Malformed selected vocabulary; not silently retained from old eight-operation schema.

semanticCases.given: Same known key/request after support withdrawn.
semanticCases.expected: Return retained outcome/current authorized disclosure before fresh-support admission; never execute again.

semanticCases.given: Known key with different semantic request and currently unsupported member.
semanticCases.expected: Conflict wins; never reclassify as a new unsupported invocation.

semanticCases.given: Same key switches singleton to version1 batch context.
semanticCases.expected: Conflict in same namespace; no duplicate execution, explicit changed-contract choice.

semanticCases.given: Final covered state unchanged, no other durable semantic effect.
semanticCases.expected: changedfalse/no transaction or lifecycle facts; retain successful key outcome and resolution witnesses.

semanticCases.given: Commit succeeds but delivery fails.
semanticCases.expected: Unknown until known disposition; recover same frozen key, never a fresh key.

semanticCases.given: Duplicate while original pending.
semanticCases.expected: Bounded wait or idempotency-in-progress Problem, no pending public receipt.

semanticCases.given: Staged complete result exceeds bound.
semanticCases.expected: Whole request refuses before effects commit; no pages/truncation/prefix.

semanticCases.given: Equivalent creation labels renamed in retained retry.
semanticCases.expected: Normalize creator slots; project requested operationName by unchanged index, IDs/outcomes/transaction fixed.

semanticCases.given: Forward/unknown/wrong-kind handle or handle in Type/id/revision position.
semanticCases.expected: Whole-batch contextual refusal; schema string acceptance is not resolution.

semanticCases.given: A properties string is @task or template-looking text.
semanticCases.expected: Literal data; no capture/interpolation.

semanticCases.given: Created identity deleted before atomic publication.
semanticCases.expected: One allocated URI/kind outcome, changedtrue and durable nonreuse; no fictional Resource revision or lifecycle Event.

semanticCases.given: A to B to A staged edits in one batch.
semanticCases.expected: One unchanged final Resource outcome and original envelope; no intermediate revision/provenance/Event.

semanticCases.given: Two owned Links change in one batch.
semanticCases.expected: Final captures use final Link records; owner publishes at most one revision and final source pairs; Types owns membership semantics.

semanticCases.given: Final changed Resources in an effectful batch.
semanticCases.expected: One postimage/optional delta fact per final Resource transition, canonical URI order and common transaction; no per-member event assumption.

semanticCases.given: Current authorization withholds one retained postimage.
semanticCases.expected: Whole retained-result refusal/current policy, no partial success or new execution.

semanticCases.given: Controlled retained content erased/expired.
semanticCases.expected: Truthful Problems, compact successful-key evidence survives; no old content or reexecution.

semanticCases.given: Later template package wants typed parameters.
semanticCases.expected: Explicit new version/materialization; version1 strings and @name meanings unchanged.

semanticCases.given: Service has individual CRUD but no atomic owner.
semanticCases.expected: No batch advertisement/emulated subprocess loop or fallback sequence.

semanticCases.given: Incoming batch routed to executable.
semanticCases.expected: Check registered version/atomic support before one whole-document invocation; serve details remain deferred.

semanticCases.given: Current feature input/result bounds shrink while a successful original outcome remains within its promised detail window.
semanticCases.expected: Preserve original frozen request/result recovery under admitted bounds; no reclassification as a new over-limit invocation, truncation or reexecution. Renamed over-budget projection may refuse without forgetting original success.

semanticCases.given: Two staged edits use the same actual initial committed guard.
semanticCases.expected: Both guards compare that baseline; no intermediate revision exists.

semanticCases.given: Different explicit provenance inputs for one final Resource/owner version.
semanticCases.expected: Whole validation failure, no first/last winner; omission does not override one supplied input.

semanticCases.given: Owner gets a final version while captured Link.source pins its earlier committed revision.
semanticCases.expected: Keep the literal source pin, independent final revisions and complete final capture; no repin or revision capture.

semanticCases.given: Different Resources share equal opaque revision strings.
semanticCases.expected: Allowed without a global revision/equality/inequality guarantee; addresses remain URI-qualified.

semanticCases.given: Existing Resource is staged updated then deleted.
semanticCases.expected: Only deleted outcome/fact of its initial final-live published revision; no staged Type/version leak.

semanticCases.given: Delete owned Links and their source Bead in one batch.
semanticCases.expected: No intermediate owner version; Link source pairs identify the deleted source final-live baseline revision and its final deleted row.
